full_prompt_en: A square classical landscape watercolor shows a cultivated green valley beyond a still lake, enclosed by trees and pale distant mountains. The sky is light blue-gray, with large soft white clouds rising above the mountain ridge. Across the middle distance, layered wooded hills move from dark olive at the sides to misty blue-green toward the center. A pale rocky mountain occupies the upper middle, its sloping faces washed with cool gray and cream so that it appears farther away than the foreground trees. In the valley below, open yellow-green lawns are crossed by a narrow winding road. Small groups of trees and a tiny pale building sit among the fields, while a few minute figures near the water provide scale without taking attention from the landscape. A tall tree with a warm brown trunk stands on the left, its broad irregular canopy extending inward; another dense tree frames the right edge. The lower foreground is darker and more textured, with clustered shrubs, rocks, and earthy brown banks surrounding the blue-gray lake. The water reflects an open patch of sky and nearby foliage in smooth subdued tones, making a calm horizontal pause between the detailed banks and the receding land. Gentle daylight brightens the open lawns and mountain while deeper cool shade remains under the trees. Fine foliage marks, transparent color washes, and carefully varied edges keep the scene detailed yet airy. The framed view, soft atmospheric distance, and broad balance of water, pasture, and trees create an ordered pastoral calm.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形古典风景水彩描绘静湖之外经过整理的绿色山谷，两旁树木环绕，远处是浅色山脉。天空呈浅蓝灰色，大片柔软白云升起在山脊上方。中远处层叠林丘从两侧深橄榄绿渐变至中央带雾感的蓝绿。上方中央有一座浅色岩山，斜坡以冷灰和奶油色淡洗，使它比前景树木显得更远。山谷下方，开阔的黄绿色草坪被一条窄窄弯路穿过。小树群和一座浅色小建筑散在田野间，水边还有极小的人影提供尺度，却不夺走对风景的注意。左侧一棵暖褐树干的高树伸出宽阔不规则的树冠；另一棵浓密大树框住右边。下方前景更暗、纹理更丰富，聚集的灌木、岩石和土褐岸坡围绕着蓝灰色湖水。水面以平滑克制的色调映出一片天空与附近枝叶，在细密岸边和退远土地之间形成安静的横向停顿。柔和日光照亮开阔草坪和山体，树下仍保留更深的冷影。细小叶片笔痕、透明洗色和细心变化的边缘让景物细致却通透。被树木框住的视角、柔和的空气远景，以及水、牧场和树木的宽阔平衡，构成有秩序的田园宁静。
style_prompt_en: Classical landscape watercolor combines transparent pale washes with precise small foliage marks and controlled dark foreground accents. Broad green and yellow-green areas give the central field room to breathe, while blue-gray distance and a light cloudy sky soften as they recede. The darkest olive and brown masses gather at the lateral and lower margins, framing a brighter open center. Edges shift from relatively crisp trunks, rocks, and near vegetation to dissolved distant slopes and cloud contours. Diffuse daylight lifts selected open planes without harsh shadows, and smooth reflective passages interrupt the busier botanical texture. Layered horizontal depth, gentle winding lines, and balanced natural framing create an orderly, airy pastoral rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 古典风景水彩把透明的浅色洗染与精细小叶片笔痕、受控的深暗前景点缀结合。宽阔绿与黄绿色域让中央场地保持呼吸感，蓝灰远景和浅色云天随着退远逐渐柔化。最深的橄榄绿与褐色体块聚在两侧和下缘，框住更亮的开阔中心。边缘从相对清晰的树干、岩石和近处植物，转为融化的远坡与云轮廓。漫射日光抬亮选定的开阔平面而没有硬影，平滑反光段落打断繁密植物纹理。层叠的横向纵深、柔和蜿蜒的线条与均衡自然框景构成整齐而通透的田园节奏。
theme_en: A cultivated green valley with a reflective lake and pale mountains
theme_zh: 有倒映湖水和浅色山脉的绿色田园山谷
name: 田园风景水彩画法
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
